question: Does ReorderCapabilityV1 fail closed under systematic receipt mutation and preserve evidence monotonicity?

attempt0_failure.observed: 55/55 mutations rejected, but 1/19 evidence-monotonicity comparisons failed because V0 greedily switched between overlapping two-operator regions.
attempt0_failure.repair: Strict V1 activates no proper subregion inside a maximal base-flexible segment; it opens the segment only when every unordered pair is locally verified.

properties.mutation_rejection: Every isolated structural, binding, verifier, proof, digest, or scope mutation verifies zero pairs and leaves all operators fixed.
properties.semantic_replay: Artifact mutations are tested both with stale and attacker-recomputed proof digests.
properties.runtime_binding: Replacing a callable after receipt issuance invalidates its SourceIndexV1 binding.
properties.evidence_monotonicity: For every pair of receipt subsets A subset B, the set of operators unfixed under A is a subset of that under B.
properties.complete_cover: Only the complete three-pair cover opens the full three-operator region.

pass_rule: All mutations fail closed, callable replacement is rejected, all subset monotonicity comparisons hold, and full-region admission occurs exactly for complete pair coverage.
claim_boundary: Adversarial mechanism calibration over generated mutations; not formal verification of the Python implementation and not real-operator coverage.
